new_value: Python oracle mirrors decided option (b) SIID-indexed TOFU key selection (spec 02 4.2 normative policy), no wire change (frame.py untouched). Changes: (1) python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py _find_sender: after loopback check, pinned-SIID block resolves _pinned_keys[SIID->IID] under _security_lock and, if pinned, verifies ONLY against the pinned key - failure logs and returns None WITHOUT falling back to trial verification or key substitution (rules 2+4); on success binds canonical PeerIdentity and re-checks canonical.iid == SIID (post-match SIID<->key binding). Unpinned SIIDs retain rule 3 paths in order: rekeyed candidates (self._rekeyed_peers), hinted peer_lookup, bounded exhaustive peer_lookup_all, then zero-hop canonical-Announce bootstrap (dual transcript: inner announce sig + outer link sig, hop_count==0, originator==signer) - relayed announces can never bootstrap their outer signer. (2) Rule 5 eviction: replay.py adds ReplayProtector._reset_owned (owner-token-gated: pops windows/floors/pins for the sender) and link_layer._retire_evicted_peer_unlocked now calls it, so evicting a (SIID, key) binding invalidates ALL replay state for that signer. (3) test updates matching the normative semantics: tests/link/test_link_rx.py pinned-SIID unverifiable frame now yields BAD_SIGNATURE fail-closed (was KEY_CHANGE; an unauthenticated frame cannot establish key-change evidence); tests/schc/test_fragment.py eviction tests assert replay state invalidated (highest == -1) instead of preserved floor. Rekey/rotation paths structurally unaffected: rekey creates a NEW key-derived identity (new IID/SIID) with occupied-state preflight; pinned-first only governs already-pinned SIIDs; rekeyed frames flow through the rekeyed-candidates loop. Acceptance: tests/link 836 passed/12 skipped; new vector tests 14/14 (test_relay_signer_chain_vectors.py drives every 1lgt case through production LinkLayer); ruff check clean on all touched files, new test file ruff-format clean; full python suite failures all verified pre-existing at HEAD via clean worktree baseline (filed discovered beads: ccp_slot_hash_carry collection error, short-addr/dad crc32_init drift, edhoc flaky, crypto ruff I001).
